senses.gloss: m. (שְׁרֵי) = הֶיתֵּר, permission; it is permitted.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1:9">Y. Dem. II, 22ᶜ</cite> <he>המיתון נהיגין … ש׳</he> (not <he>נגיחין</he>) I saw them treat the fig-cake as permitted.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1:9">Ib.</cite> <he>כל דחמי מיא ש׳</he> all the land that faces the sea is permitted; a. e.
